acceptanceCriteria: OpenCode maintained qualification tests and their required producer/tooling path comply with GOC-V0-008 without a Python interpreter dependency.
Producer/report validation, architecture normalization and interruption cleanup retain meaningful executable coverage.
The no-python-runtime-dependency gate and relevant host/qualification regressions pass without weakening the accepted Go-only boundary.
body: Observed at 3a6345491049c54db32eb53afdf6ccd20f4d4ef2 while checking the remaining terminal-gate steps after a version blocker. make no-python-runtime-dependency-test fails GOC-V0-008 on integrations/opencode-qualification.test.mjs lines12,16,38,86,103: Python interpreter invocations in maintained test/producer paths. Introduced by885264baa9b3bd7cf4c43669e4cd983f99480847 before the journal/lock fix base. Still present at OpenCode0.7.1 PR333 head b2676d3a15b36fe714510fe6726eee5e441ce5ad. The accepted Go-only contract requires maintained adapter/developer tools to have no Python interpreter dependency and safety tests to be ported to Go. Preserve producer correctness, architecture normalization and descendant-cleanup coverage; do not weaken or evade the gate. Prior V1-0213 fixed the analogous Pi issue and is not this regression. Routing to the OpenCode owner chat awaits explicit user authorization.
title: Remove Python dependency from OpenCode qualification tests and tooling
